description: This file defines the DeviceIdentity struct, which stores device identity details such as deviceId, publicKey, privateKey, and creation timestamp. It also provides functionality to generate, load, save, and sign payloads with device keys, and to determine appropriate storage paths for the device identity data.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity data from file or creates a new identity if none exists or data is invalid.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a given payload string using the device's private key and returns the signature as a URL-safe Base64 encoded string.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new DeviceIdentity instance by creating a new key pair and assigning a deviceId based on the public key.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes Data into a URL-safe Base64 string.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key encoded in URL-safe Base64 format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a DeviceIdentity object to a file in JSON format.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL for storing the device identity data.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Determines the directory URL for storing device state, checking environment variables and system directories.
